routing_warnings.description: The freelancer's claim concerns the independently performed text proofreading rather than the voiceover audit.
The client's rejection and restart statement explicitly concern the text deliverable.
The allegation that the text audit was performed through AI primarily concerns the independently inventoried text-review method.
The freelancer's statement that the revision was personal proofreading primarily concerns who performed the review and how it was performed, not demonstrated text accuracy.
The proposed AI-use recheck is a validation-method condition and does not report an executed result for text accuracy or usability.
The client rejects the text as unusable, which concerns text accuracy and usability rather than the review method alone.
The freelancer's claim that the proofreading is accurate concerns the text's accuracy rather than its review method.
The freelancer's repeated accuracy claim belongs to the Danish text accuracy and usability Requirement.
